Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Low","gaps":"Inconsistent allergen management, missing cleaning validation records, reactive equipment maintenance, high staff turnover","recommendations":"Implement standardized allergen management procedures, establish cleaning validation protocols, transition to preventive maintenance schedules, develop a comprehensive training program to retain competency","standards":"ISO 22000, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001"}
